items.name: BIP-Brain
items.description: A platform that helps radiologists and neurologists diagnose Alzheimer's and Multiple Sclerosis from medical images. I built the front-end: 30+ screens from Figma, authentication, sign-up and the integration with the REST APIs.

items.name: Prodigium
items.description: An agency that ships professional websites and landing pages in up to 15 business days. I built the site's front-end with Astro, focused on performance and responsive layout.

items.name: Automatic security for microservices
items.description: A study of code generation with js-distributor for authentication and authorization: Keycloak and RBAC mechanisms generated automatically while migrating a monolith to microservices, focused on propagating security context between services. Advised by Prof. Daniel Lucredio, UFSCar.

journey.title: Where I've been and what I shipped

items.title: Data Engineer & Full-stack Developer (Internship)
lines: Mapped the full user journey, from first visit to conversion, with Python and BigQuery to produce strategic marketing insights.
Built an internal platform in React + TypeScript (Next.js) that replaced static dashboards with a dynamic interface connected to data services through APIs.
Built 10 integration pipelines in production (Cloud Run) consuming the REST APIs of Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, HubSpot, RD Station and other platforms.
Built the front-end of company websites with Astro, focused on performance and responsive layout.
Implemented tracking with GA4 and Google Tag Manager, sending conversions in parallel to GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads and Microsoft Ads.
Built customer-service AI agents with LangChain.
Used AI-assisted development (Claude Code) to ship features faster and keep code standards, always with review.

items.title: Front-end Developer
lines: Built 30+ screens in React + TypeScript with Next.js from Figma prototypes, covering user and admin roles, the landing page, authentication and sign-up.
Built reusable components, favoring simple, clean and readable code.
Connected the front-end to the back-end REST APIs and implemented sign-up, login and user sessions.
Documented the React components with Storybook and versioned the work with Git.
FAPESP Technical Training scholarship in Web Development.
